scripts.postinstall: echo 'Skipping forge install - run manually if needed'
scripts.build: if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1; then forge build; else echo 'Skipping contracts build - forge not installed'; fi
scripts.test: if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1; then forge test -vv; else echo 'Skipping contracts tests - forge not installed'; fi
scripts.lint: if command -v forge >/dev/null 2>&1; then forge fmt --check; else echo 'Skipping contracts lint - forge not installed'; fi
scripts.typecheck: echo 'Contracts use Solidity - no TypeScript typecheck'
